content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"List the project documents and read the documents needed to identify the three allowed gas-mixture candidates and the laboratory environmental/safety requirements, especially candidate_specs.md and any policy or gas-system safety documents."},{"id":"s2","description":"Extract the three permitted mixture definitions from candidate_specs.md and screen them against the environmental and safety policy documents; exclude any candidate that is explicitly non-compliant, and keep the compliant candidate list for simulation."},{"id":"s3","description":"For each compliant candidate mixture, run simulate_time_resolution at representative gas gaps spanning the allowed 1–3 mm range, including 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, and 3.0 mm. Record each numeric time-resolution result with record_results."},{"id":"s4","description":"Identify the best-performing region from the coarse scan, then run additional simulations around the lowest time-resolution gap for each promising mixture using finer gap spacing within 1–3 mm. Record all numeric results."},{"id":"s5","description":"Compare all recorded simulation results and select the single compliant mixture and gas gap with the minimum simulated time resolution. Prepare the selected mixture name/composition, gap in mm, and supporting best-resolution value for the reporting module."}]}
